Name: Dwarven Network
Author: ItsOrnery
Description:
[center][b] What it does:[/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]- Link multiple chests into one shared storage network[/center]
[center]- Browse everything from a central Access Terminal[/center]
[center]- Search for items quickly[/center]
[center]- Sort and filter your storage[/center]
[center]- Deposit and withdraw items without opening every chest[/center]
[center]- Craft from linked storage with the Crafting Terminal[/center]
[center]- Fully compatible with multiplayer

[b]Great for players who:
[/b]
- Hoard everything
- Hate digging through rows of chests
- Want a more organized farm
- Want easier crafting from stored materials
[/center]

[center][b]Recipes:[/b][/center]
[spoiler][center][/center]
[center]- Dwarven Tuning Wand: 1 Copper Bar, 10 Stone, unlocks at Mining Level 4[/center]
[center]- Dwarven Core: 5 Copper Bars, 1 Iron Bar, 50 Stone, unlocks at Mining Level 4[/center]
[center]- Access Terminal: 2 Copper Bars, 1 Iron Bar, 35 Stone, unlocks at Mining Level 4[/center]
[center]- Crafting Terminal: 2 Copper Bars, 1 Gold Bar, 45 Stone, unlocks at Mining Level 8[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Use the Dwarven Tuning Wand to link chests into the network, then place the terminals to manage and craft from your stored items.[/center]
[/spoiler]

[center][b]Requirements:[/b][/center]
[center]- SMAPI[/center]
[center]- Content Patcher[/center]
[center]- StardewUI (Continued)[/center]
[center]- Generic Mod Config Menu is optional, but highly recommended.[/center]

[center][b]Installation:[/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Download the mod, extract it into your `Mods` folder, and launch the game with SMAPI.[/center]

[center][b]Compatibility:[/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]The mod is built in a way to ensure broad compatibility with other mods, it does not change the chests connected only manages the items inside it.[/center]
[center]100% compatible with mods such as automate, bigger chests, unlimited storage and such![/center]
[center]If you find any incompatibilities do let me know![/center]

[center][b]Dont forget to endorse the mod so more people can find out about it,[/b][/center]
[center][b]Thanks![/b][/center]
